answer: Mirror-Ember Raven Attestation: each agent's state root is periodically challenged; honest replies reuse cached computation (one cheap replay), while cloned identities must re-derive divergent histories, paying full compute plus a raven audit that samples prior epochs. The mirror commits a hash of each agent's action log; an ember flag marks recent mutations. N clones thus cost N times the re-derivation and audit work, versus one replay for an honest agent.
